name: Git
tagline: Change, commit and share a repository

offers.label: Refresh
offers.description: Reads the repository on disk into the app's records, for this person's window.

offers.label: Open repository
offers.description: Opens the repository at `path` on this device.

offers.label: Choose repository
offers.description: Starts choosing a repository's folder, listing this device's home folder.

offers.label: Open browsed
offers.description: Opens the folder the picker shows as a repository.

offers.label: Close picker
offers.description: Puts the picker away.

offers.label: Stage all
offers.description: Stages every change.

offers.label: Unstage all
offers.description: Takes every staged change back out of the next commit.

offers.label: Commit staged changes
offers.description: Creates a commit from what is staged.

offers.label: Create branch
offers.description: Creates a branch and switches to it.

offers.label: Checkout branch
offers.description: Switches to a branch, asking what becomes of uncommitted work when there is any.

offers.label: Switch stashing
offers.description: Answers the switch question by parking the uncommitted work on the stash first.

offers.label: Switch carrying
offers.description: Answers the switch question by carrying the uncommitted work along.

offers.label: Cancel switch
offers.description: Puts the switch question away.

offers.label: Switch to
offers.description: Switches to `name`, parking the uncommitted work when `stash` says so.

offers.label: Delete branch
offers.description: Deletes a local branch.

offers.label: Branch on key
offers.description: The key pressed on a branch's row: `Enter` switches to it, and `Delete` deletes it when it is a

offers.label: Stash working changes
offers.description: Stashes the working tree's changes, with a message.

offers.label: Apply stash
offers.description: Applies a stash, leaving it in the list.

offers.label: Create worktree
offers.description: Makes a new branch at `start` and a working directory of its own.

offers.label: Fetch from remote
offers.description: Fetches from a remote.

offers.label: Pull from remote
offers.description: Fetches, then fast-forwards the current branch to its upstream.

offers.label: Push to remote
offers.description: Pushes the current branch to a like-named branch on a remote.

offers.label: Run approved project check
offers.description: Runs a check this project's host approved, by its id: the host picks the commands, the sources

asks.name: check_id
asks.description: Check ID approved by this exact project host

offers.label: Stop check
offers.description: Stops the running check; the host ends its commands.

offers.label: Clear check
offers.description: Puts the last check's result away.

offers.label: Read commit
offers.description: Reads a commit's changed files and their diffs when it is opened.

offers.label: Commit on key
offers.description: The key pressed on a commit's row: `Enter` opens its changed files, and `Backspace` or `Escape`

offers.label: Clear trouble
offers.description: Puts the trouble banner away.

offers.label: Clear notice
offers.description: Puts the notice banner away.
